SACCA YAMAKA—PAIRS ON TRUTH but suﬀering-truth. With the exception of suﬀering and suﬀering-truth, the remaining is neither suﬀering nor suﬀering-truth. They are not truths. Are they not cessation-truth? ...pe ... They are truths. Are they not path-truth? Yes. 17. It is not origination. Is it not origination-truth? Yes. They are not truths. Are they not suﬀering-truth? They are not truths. Are they not Path-truth? Yes. 19. It is not Path. Is it not path-truth? Yes. They are not truths. Are they not suﬀering-truth? Yes. It is not path. Is it not path-truth? Yes. They are not truths; Are they not origination-truth? ...pe ... 3. Chapter on Pure Truth Suddhasaccav¯ara Positive (Anuloma) 20. It is suﬀering. Is it truth? Yes. They are truths. Are they suﬀering-truth? Suﬀering-truth is both truth and suﬀering-truth. The remaining are truths, but not suﬀering- truth. It is origination. It is truth? Yes. ...pe ... It is cessation. Is it truth? Yes. ...pe ... It is Path, Is it truth? Yes. They are truths. Are they path-truth? Path-truth is both truth and path-truth. The remaining are truths but not path-truth. Negative (Paccan¯ika) 21. It is suﬀering. Is it not truth? With the exception of suﬀering, the remaining truths are not suﬀering, but truths. With the exception of suﬀering and truth, the remaining is neither suﬀering nor truths. They are truths. Are they not suﬀering-truth? Yes.
